narration: You've been swiping that rewards card thinking you're winning. But here's the thing — most of those points are quietly dying before you ever use them.
visual: Dark background. Center: a loyalty rewards credit card (rectangle with chip and three gold stars) springs in. Gold stars rain down from above, then three of them get red X marks slashed through them.

narration: Americans are sitting on forty-eight billion dollars in unredeemed loyalty points right now. And the average household loses five hundred and twelve dollars to expiration every single year.
visual: Light background. A pink piggy bank with coins leaking from a hole in its side. Large '$48B' counter animates up from zero. An amber highlight box reveals '$512 EXPIRES UNUSED EVERY YEAR'.

narration: You're enrolled in roughly fifteen loyalty programs but actively use fewer than seven. The other eight are quietly counting down to zero.
visual: Dark background. A grid of 15 circles pops in one by one — 7 glowing amber labeled with program types (active), 8 dark gray with red X marks (inactive, expiring). Stats show '14.8 enrolled, only 6.7 used'.

narration: Airlines expire your miles after eighteen months of no activity. Hotels delete your points in twelve. Your credit card buries the expiration deadline in forty-seven pages of fine print.
visual: Light background. Three icons appear in sequence from top: an airplane (blue) labeled '18 MONTHS INACTIVITY', a hotel bed (green) labeled '12 MONTHS INACTIVITY', and a red credit card labeled 'BURIED IN THE FINE PRINT'.

narration: And here's what makes it even worse — airlines have slashed the value of your miles by forty-three percent since 2015. Your points are losing purchasing power even as you wait to use them.
visual: Dark background. A bar chart showing airline mile value declining: 2015 (1.5 cents, green), 2018 (1.2 cents, amber), 2021 (1.0 cents, orange), 2024 (0.85 cents, red). Bars animate up, then a dashed red trend line connects the tops with '-43% VALUE' label.

narration: Check every loyalty account you have this week. Use the points, transfer them, or cash out before they vanish. Follow for more money traps nobody warned you about.
visual: Light background. A phone showing a loyalty tracker app with a warning banner '3 EXPIRING SOON'. Three green checkmarks animate in one by one: USE YOUR POINTS NOW, TRANSFER OR CASH OUT, SET EXPIRY REMINDERS. Amber 'FOLLOW FOR MORE MONEY TRAPS' CTA at bottom.
